title: Armenian Foreign Minister Mirzoyan visits Latvia
summary_full: On 7th September, the Latvian Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, is hosting her Armenian counterpart, Ararat Mirzoyan, who is visiting Latvia from 6th to 8th September.
